headline: ARI @ TEX matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is ARI 3.77 at TEX 4.43, with a projected total of 8.20. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward TEX: ARI moved -0.12 runs while TEX moved +0.09, changing the projected margin by -0.21 runs. NRFI probability rose +15.4%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Kumar Rocker has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available start logs at 2.6 ER over the last 5 starts. Batter research is strongest for Ezequiel Duran, Josh Jung, Ildemaro Vargas, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Corey Seager, Jose Fernandez because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
